answer: Commit-reveal work receipts price sybil accounts in compute, not in signups. An agent hashes its result with a per-epoch nonce, publishes that hash, then reveals the payload one block later, so a copycat cannot ride the same tide before the window shuts. A lottery-picked auditor reruns the job and compares the reveal against fresh output, slashing the bond on mismatch; it gains nothing from passing a fake. Each fake identity then costs one real run plus a locked bond renewed every pulse of the epoch clock, while one zephyr of copied hashes across unrelated addresses flags the cluster.
